record_title: Dimension-two boundary for double transvection commutators
provenance: A field-level classification identifies the exact dimension-two obstruction to an identity double commutator with transvections, and a real specialization recovers the unipotence conclusion in dimension two.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The work by K. Muliarchyk cited in arXiv:2609.17006v2 was not independently located or inspected; because the source attributes a field-case rank-one result to its Proposition 5.1, hidden dimension-two coverage is the principal residual originality risk. The real unipotence extension is not asserted over arbitrary fields. No independent validation is asserted.
